query_results.query_text: My handset took a dip in the toilet — will my protection plan cover the repair?

synthesis.response_text: Yes, your protection plan covers accidental liquid immersion, including drops in toilets, provided the damage was accidental and not due to intentional submersion beyond the device’s rated water-resistance level. Please do not attempt to charge your device, keep it in a dry environment, and file your claim within 48 hours for the best results.

query_results.query_text: I want to file a claim for my broken screen.

synthesis.response_text: To file a claim for your broken screen, log in to your account at my.carrier.com, navigate to 'Insurance & Protection', and select 'File a Claim'. Alternatively, you can initiate the process by calling 1-800-555-0147. You will need your device's IMEI number, the date of the incident, and a description of the damage to submit your claim.

To file a claim, please note that your eligibility is subject to the claim frequency limits of your specific insurance plan, which range from two claims per year to unlimited depending on your coverage. You may wish to check your account portal or contact customer support for the filing process.

To file a claim for your broken screen, log in to your account at my.carrier.com, navigate to "Insurance & Protection," and select "File a Claim." You can also initiate the process by calling 1-800-555-0147. Please have your device's IMEI number, the incident date, and a brief description ready, and ensure your claim is filed within 60 days of the damage.
